verification_scope: Owned local full-ROM rebuild receipt; CI validates current source evidence and does not obtain the ROM.
source_data_scope: Relocated local C data and included assets; not semantic format-identification credit.

compiler_recipe.sizes: ELF STT_FUNC sizes; zero sizes inferred to next function or section end; gaps unattributed

function_inventory.scope: Main-source inventory; not the complete European ROM function total.
function_inventory.draft_scope: Readable alternate C definitions; compilation and matching are separate checks.
function_inventory.naming_scope: Existing descriptive identifiers; semantic correctness not independently audited.

additional_inventory.scope: Compiled source function instances in separate programs; no European matching credit.
